image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a fish, identified as a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor), swimming near a coral reef. The fish has a distinct black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow-green posterior body and tail. The background consists of red and brown coral textures. There is visible text overlay at the bottom of the image.
